outfit.name: 极简青灰双面羊绒长大衣与禁欲黑丝
outfit.prose: A tailored slate-blue double-faced cashmere trench coat with sharp architectural lapels, worn open over an ivory ribbed turtleneck knit and a high-waisted black slit pencil skirt. Accompanied by 30D sheer black tights, a slim matte black leather thigh band with a brushed silver buckle, and pointed-toe leather ankle boots.
